[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Melia-sama, it's good to[XENO:n ]
see you again so soon.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
Did everything go well-mo?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
And what of your men?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

They are at one with the Giant God. They[XENO:n ]
sacrificed their lives so that I might escape.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT12 ]But this is not my reason for coming.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]These Homs need your help. Will you be[XENO:n ]
so kind as to listen to their request?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Is that what the Hom Hom want-mo?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]They require safe passage to Eryth Sea.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]That's fine, but what will[XENO:n ]
you do, Melia-sama-ja-mo?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]I have unfinished business in this region.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

Once these Homs are safely on their way,[XENO:n ]
I shall be on mine as well.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]That girl...something's troubling her.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]We found her half-dead and all alone. But I don't[XENO:n ]
suppose she'll tell us the reason any time soon.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Maybe we can help.[XENO:n ]
I'll go and talk to her.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
